conditions.same_referent: the value of a second, correlated observer's projection in the G4 ambiguity-set model
conditions.same_scale: local-component: the 20x20 grid model, not the field's own observer set
conditions.notes: Locates the boundary of CLM-0014's warning. A second observer sharing the first's projection direction still narrows ambiguity (60.00 vs 80.00 at 0 degrees) when its partition granularity differs; the shared blind spot becomes total only when direction AND partition coincide. CLM-0014 holds exactly at that limit and weakens continuously away from it - correlation of errors is a matter of degree, measured here as an angle.
